# connection reference

A connection is a shared link to something outside the node, named by the steps that use it.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the module's schema, not this file. -->

## `connection:influxdb`

A connection to an InfluxDB write endpoint. It cannot serve a remote config; only MQTT can.

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | **yes** |  |  | The write endpoint, such as "http://127.0.0.1:8086/api/v2/write". |
| `organization` | string | **yes** |  |  | The InfluxDB organization to write into. |
| `bucket` | string | **yes** |  |  | The bucket to write into. |
| `token` | string | **yes** |  |  | An API token with write permission on the bucket. |
| `precision` | `ns` or `us` or `ms` or `s` | no | `"ms"` |  | The timestamp precision the written lines carry. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | `false` |  | Leave this step out of the task. |
| `name` | string | no |  |  | A label for this step, used in error messages. |

## `connection:mqtt`

A connection to an MQTT broker, shared by every trigger and output that names it.

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | string | **yes** |  |  | The broker to connect to, such as "mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883". Credentials belong in username and password rather than in the URL. |
| `username` | string | no |  |  | The username to authenticate with, when the broker wants one. |
| `password` | string | no |  |  | The password to authenticate with, when the broker wants one. |
| `clientId` | string | no |  |  | The client identifier to present to the broker. Defaults to a generated one. |
| `keepalive` | number | no |  | `s` | How long the broker should wait before considering this client gone. Must be at least 0. |
| `reconnectPeriod` | number | no |  | `ms` | How long to wait before retrying a dropped connection. Must be at least 0. |
| `connectTimeout` | number | no |  | `ms` | How long to wait for the broker to accept a connection. Must be at least 0. |
| `clean` | boolean | no |  |  | Start a fresh session rather than resuming the one this client id left behind. |
| `rejectUnauthorized` | boolean | no |  |  | For a TLS endpoint, refuse a certificate that does not verify. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | `false` |  | Leave this step out of the task. |
| `name` | string | no |  |  | A label for this step, used in error messages. |
